responsibility: Implements statement simplification and condition reasoning driven by value-range information in GCC’s VRP/ranger framework. It queries SSA ranges to prove comparisons, detect guaranteed or impossible overflow, rewrite arithmetic and boolean expressions, simplify divisions/modulos, abs, bit operations, min/max, conversions, switches, and internal calls, and mark CFG edges unreachable, making it the transformation layer that turns range facts into optimized GIMPLE.
same_name_distinction: Implements the range-driven simplification engine declared in vr-values.h. This .cc contains the actual GIMPLE transformation and condition/switch reasoning code that consumes range_query results.
